title: Bryony Body
specs: Classes suited for beginners through advanced levels
Wellness and healing services designed to fit a variety of needs

options.name: Unlimited Membership (in-person, virtual, on-demand)
options.detail: Unlimited in-person, virtual, and stored, on-demand classes; 10% discount on special events and workshops; requires auto withdrawal; cancel anytime with email.

options.name: Unlimited Virtual Membership
options.detail: Unlimited virtual and stored, on-demand classes; 10% discount on special events and workshops; requires auto withdrawal.

options.name: Class Pack 10 Sessions
options.detail: 10 in-studio sessions, expires 1 year from first use

options.name: Class Pack 20 Sessions
options.detail: 20 in-studio sessions, expires 1 year from first use

options.name: Class Pack 30 Sessions
options.detail: 30 in-studio sessions, expires 1 year from first use

options.name: Level 1 Yoga Class
options.detail: Beginner-friendly yoga focusing on alignment and foundational asanas with breath-to-movement connection and pose modifications.

options.name: Level 2 Yoga Class
options.detail: Intermediate yoga building on Level 1 with more advanced postures and pose modifications.

options.name: Level 3 Non-Heated Power Flow
options.detail: Advanced power vinyasa flow with balance, core strengthening, flexibility, moving at a faster pace to upbeat music.

options.name: Gentle Yoga
options.detail: Beginner to all-levels gentle yoga with joint and spine warm-ups, traditional postures, breathing, and relaxation at own pace.

options.name: Restorative Yoga
options.detail: Grounding yoga with passive postures supported by props, promoting relaxation, reduced pain, improved sleep and wellbeing; limited to 10 students.

options.name: Strength and Conditioning
options.detail: Full body workout mixing calisthenics, bodyweight, interval and strength training focusing on functional movement, strength, and endurance.

options.name: Barre Yoga Fusion
options.detail: Low-impact, high energy barre and yoga fusion for flexibility, tone, strength, breathing, and muscle lengthening for all fitness levels.
